title: Agent Router: route complex AI work with reasons
audience: Engineers who need a complex request decomposed into attributable tasks instead of sent through a blind round-robin.
promise: Turn one high-risk launch-readiness request into a typed graph, compare credible routes, retain bounded worker receipts, and expose disagreement before synthesis.
story: A labeled synthetic launch-readiness request becomes plan, execute, and verify nodes with authority constraints attached.
The native replay compares candidates with task-specific evidence, explicit unknowns, and a stable selection trace.
A bounded replay keeps one worker receipt attached to each selected subtask without claiming a live provider session.
A seeded conflict remains visible and selects model_synthesis, but the current native output still lacks final confidence and fallback fields.
verified_locally: AR-1 through AR-4 are closed for the labeled replay/spec slice.
The native candidate packet records stable route ordering and a Codex winner for the selected replay subtasks.
The bounded execution replay keeps three synthetic worker receipts attributable and records zero provider invocations.
The native conflict probe detects disagreement and selects model_synthesis while preserving fixture receipt IDs and rationale.
The 1600x900 preview is rendered from the same bounded case and visually inspected.
open_gates: Add or approve confidence and fallback fields in the synthesis output contract.
Rerun disagreement and missing-result probes, then reconcile receipt totals.
Keep provider, worktree, cost, and real launch-readiness claims separate from replay evidence.
Verify a hosted no-auth case and external destination readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves a labeled replay/spec, candidate-selection trace, bounded synthetic execution, and a reviewed local visual explorer. It does not claim live provider execution, worktree mutation, currency cost, final confidence/fallback output, hosting, or publication.
